annotations.annotation_text: The Istanbul setting introduces Old World historical texture to the cyberpunk narrative, contrasting ancient Byzantine-Ottoman architecture with corporate surveillance and high-tech intrigue.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 93.

annotations.target_phrase: The Finn, in a new Shinjuku suit, sarariman black
annotations.annotation_text: The Finn's comical masquerade as a Japanese corporate 'salaryman' (sarariman), highlighting the cultural domination of Japanese corporate etiquette across international criminal operations.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 93.
